Round Mound Course

Biotped · Quadruped · Round-Mound Course

Straight line, then straight up the cake.

No obstacles this round, a mound climbable from any direction, and a reward that rewards raw speed instead of a fixed pace. The difference shows: this run clears all 4 checkpoints and summits the mound in under 6 seconds — the first full course completion across every version of this environment so far.

What changed the outcome

vs. the obstacle version

  • Obstacle course (15M steps, straight staircase): 0/15 completions, 0/15 ever climbed
  • This version (12M steps, fewer steps needed): 8/15 completions — the first time any seed has finished
  • Removing obstacles removed most of the failure surface; the round mound removes the "wrong approach angle" failure too

Still not fully reliable

  • 7/15 seeds still fall — a few fail almost immediately at spawn, a pattern seen since the very first walk policy and still unexplained
  • Only evaluated on the fixed checkpoint layout — randomize=True (new layout each episode) untested
  • 53% is a real result, not a solved task
Model: runs/course/model_final.zip (12M steps, static layout) · Env: course_env.py / scene_course.xml · Evaluated deterministically on 15 fresh seeds
